description: Dept. of  Loacal Govt. Eastern Province - Notice on summon meetings of Local Authorities, Trincomalee Urban Council and Samanthurai P/S
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the summoning of meetings to fill vacancies for Vice Chairman positions in local authorities (Trincomalee Urban Council and Sammanthurai Pradeshiya Sabha) resulting from resignations. The content specifically relates to electoral processes at the local government level under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and Amendment Act, making it clearly fall under the Elections category (Type 7) rather than general government personnel or organizational changes.
